function.name: event_finder_find_upcoming
function.description: Find upcoming events of a specific genre in a given location.

location.description: The city and state where the search will take place, e.g. New York, NY.

days_ahead.description: The number of days from now to include in the search.

function.name: t_test
function.description: Perform a statistical t-test to check if the means of two independent datasets are statistically different.

alpha.description: Significance level for the test. Default is 0.05. This is a float type value.

function.name: geometry_area_triangle
function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle.

base.description: The length of the base of the triangle. This is a float type value.

height.description: The height of the triangle from the base. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The measurement unit for the area. Defaults to square meters.
